name: AliExpress
label: AliExpress Open Platform TOP router (official only)
description: Official Open Platform HTTPS router api.taobao.com/router/rest. HTML scrapers disallowed. TOP sign (hmac/md5) is not computed by OfficialApiNode — send pre-signed query fields on input (method, timestamp, sign, session). access_token maps to session when used as query. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: product_query | order_list | affiliate_link | tracking. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: method
schema.description: Top-level API method name (official AliExpress gateway). Set only when overriding the op default.

schema.label: timestamp
schema.description: Query-string parameter `timestamp` for operations: product_query, order_list, affiliate_link, tracking.

schema.label: sign
schema.description: Query-string parameter `sign` for operations: product_query, order_list, affiliate_link, tracking.

schema.label: sign_method
schema.description: Query-string parameter `sign_method` for operations: product_query, order_list, affiliate_link, tracking.

schema.label: v
schema.description: Query-string parameter `v` for operations: product_query, order_list, affiliate_link, tracking.

schema.label: format
schema.description: Query-string parameter `format` for operations: product_query, order_list, affiliate_link, tracking.

schema.label: session
schema.description: Query-string parameter `session` for operations: product_query, order_list, affiliate_link, tracking.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: product_query | order_list | affiliate_link | tracking. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: StudioQuack secret. Auth type query. Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: App Key
configurationParameters.description: Open Platform app_key (query-string; input then config).

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.
